title: Five floors down
notes: Two new floors before the reactor: the flooded Pump Station and the overrun Security Wing.
The Stalker: something tall, pale and unkillable hunts you in set scenes on floors 2 to 4. Run.
THE HOST: pull the reactor breaker and the lab's nest wakes up. Kill it to call the freight lift.
New weapons: an SMG, and a crowbar that's always with you (quiet, no ammo, quick bash on V / RB).
Scripted scares: dying lights, a runner in the dark, a body that wasn't there, footsteps, a door slammed shut.
Survival mode: endless waves in the Containment Hall, with THE HOST every fifth wave.
Records screen and four unlockable extras: VHS filter, noir filter, infinite flashlight, golden guns.
Controller support (wheels and joysticks are ignored so the view never spins on its own).
Menus remade as a CRT security terminal; the HUD is now a wrist bio-monitor with a live heartbeat.

title: Performance update
notes: Far fewer draw calls: monsters, walls, decals and guns are batched together.
Cheaper glow and post-processing, one less light on every pixel, and a pixel cap for big screens.
New Auto resolution setting lowers the render resolution when the frame rate drops.
Shaders are prepared when a floor loads, so new monsters no longer cause a hitch.

title: Release
notes: Three floors under Ardent Biolabs, four monster types, pistol and shotgun, nine audio logs and the reactor finale.
